The credit for the half-year in which a Government servant is removed/ dismissed from service will be afforded at the rate of % days per completed calendar-month up to the end of the calendar month preceding the last calendar month of service. In the case of death of a Government servant while in service, credit will be afforded at the rate of% days per completed calendar month up to the date of death. - Rule 29 (2) (c) and (ca).
